_about: Public-domain Nicholas Snethen, Methodist preacher and a founder of the Methodist Protestant Church, for the Word Hoard: his Answer to James O'Kelly's Vindication, Snethen on Lay Representation, and his collected Sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 124 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
